skill.summary: Export a Codex session JSONL from ~/.codex/sessions into a clean Markdown transcript in ~/Documents/Exports. Use when the user wants to export, save, or conv...

latestVersion.changelog:
- The export script now automatically creates the ~/Documents/Exports directory if it doesn't already exist.
- Updated documentation to clarify that the export location is created as needed.
- Added a "Local Scope" section explaining which files and directories are read/written, and that no network or package operations occur.
